#+TITLE: Literal Escapes

To print a literal structure character without triggering markup, use its Org
entity: \ast{} for a star, \vert{} for a pipe, \lbrack{} \rbrack{} for brackets,
\lbrace{} \rbrace{} for braces, \under{} for an underscore, \tilde{} for a tilde,
\equal{} for an equals, \sol{} for a slash.

So \ast{}not bold\ast{} stays literal, and a table pipe \vert{} in prose is fine.
